newsitem.title: FRANCE: Market may underestimate dlr fundamentals - Trichet.
newsitem.headline: Market may underestimate dlr fundamentals - Trichet.

text.p: Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday that the market may underestimate the underlying fundamentals of the U.S. dollar.
"What counts of course are the fundamentals," Trichet told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
"It is possible that the market has a tendency to underestimate the underlying fundamentals of the dollar," Trichet said following the central bank's annual news conference.
He also said the Group of Seven rich nations was the appropriate forum to address exchange rate questions.
French politicians have called repeatedly for a rise in the dollar, which Prime Minister Alain Juppe has described as chronically undervalued.
"The G7 is the appropriate informal gathering to address such questions," Trichet said.
